actions.label: Investigate: Reset Quick Accent gesture state after arrow activation

reproduce.title: quick accent deactivates itself
prerequisites: Use the letter/language and timing settings supplied in the discussion.
Compare arrow-only, combined Left/Right or Space, and space-only without unrelated setting changes.
reproduce.expected_result: The failing transition is attributable to process, hook or UI state, and a candidate fix survives repeated activations.
steps: Repeat the supplied arrow activation sequence until the utility stops responding.
Record PowerToys.PowerAccent.exe liveness and maintainer-side hook/toolbar activity at failure.
Repeat combined mode and the reported space-only workaround; test whether restarting only Quick Accent restores it.

known_information: Multiple diagnostic archives are already attached.
The discussion narrows a reproducible case to arrow activation on 0.101.2362.
Space-only was reported as a workaround, but the latest reply says Left/Right or Space still fails like arrows.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and public discussion, current ownership, labels and linked-work history.
Read the later arrow/combined-mode counterexample, not only the original random-failure description.
KeyboardListener maintains letter/trigger/toolbar state; PowerAccent.Core manages delayed display and ForceReset, while a separate WinUI process owns the toolbar.
inferences: Gesture reset, hook state or toolbar/process liveness could explain the failure; the setting comparison alone does not select one.
issue_context.summary: Quick Accent stops reacting until restart; arrow-related settings evidence has already been supplied.
issue_context.analysis: Use the new activation-mode evidence and withdraw repeated setting/ZIP questions. A maintainer can distinguish process exit, live hook silence and invisible toolbar using the supplied sequence.

fix_assessment.rationale: This is a scoped, confidence-qualified investigation/fix proposal, not an approved or independently converged implementation design.

judgment.rationale: Use the new activation-mode evidence and withdraw repeated setting/ZIP questions. A maintainer can distinguish process exit, live hook silence and invisible toolbar using the supplied sequence.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the arrow and combined modes while observing process liveness, hook dispatch and toolbar state.
evidence: Multiple diagnostic archives are already attached.
The discussion narrows a reproducible case to arrow activation on 0.101.2362.
Space-only was reported as a workaround, but the latest reply says Left/Right or Space still fails like arrows.
Read the later arrow/combined-mode counterexample, not only the original random-failure description.
KeyboardListener maintains letter/trigger/toolbar state; PowerAccent.Core manages delayed display and ForceReset, while a separate WinUI process owns the toolbar.

confidence.rationale: The activation-mode comparison localizes the scenario, but no current failing trace distinguishes hook, state and UI liveness.

plan: Use the supplied arrow sequence in both arrow-only and combined activation modes.
Observe whether the process survives and whether hook events and toolbar requests continue after failure.
Correct only the identified reset/cancellation/lifetime boundary and cover repeated activation plus cancellation.
proposed_fixes.title: Reset Quick Accent gesture state after arrow activation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: An incomplete gesture/reset or toolbar cancellation transition may leave activation stuck; process exit remains an alternative until observed.
verification: Repeated arrow/combined activation continues working without process restart.
Space-only and press-and-hold modes remain functional; process exit is not hidden as a successful reset.
